This branch only leaves maintenance records at `docs/proposals/supply-boundary/serde-serde-cargo-toml-serde-derive-license-mit.md` and does not change the frozen implementation. package-owner needs to answer whether the combinations in the manifest are consistent with actual consumers, lockfiles, and release entry points. Evidence starts from `serde_derive/LICENSE-MIT`, using the Rust toolchain for verification; if that does not hold, withdraw combinations not substantiated by consumers, retaining only reproducible manifest changes.
